beats.say: A new essay argues the future once expected by 2035 has already arrived, years ahead of schedule.
It looks back from 2035 at how JavaScript became the default language for all software, a story told in a 2009 talk by Jeff Atwood.
And the proof is in the pudding: a new engine called unkernel runs two times to thirty-two times faster than qemu-wasm, depending on the workload, with benchmarks tracked over time.
